Here’s the little fact box, which briefly outlines Computer Lars:

Artist group, which is an association of young Jutland artists.

Computer Lars is an anagram of the author Marcel Proust.

The group creates art through artificial intelligence.

The name Computer Lars is an expression for the average person - a man and who has power, as more CEOs in Denmark are named [unreadable character]Lars[unreadable character] than there are female CEOs.

Learn more about Computer Lars and The Synthetic Party at www.computerlars.com and www.medium.com/det-syntetiske-parti.
